source: 电脑：桌面 FPS | CPU | 已用 / 总内存 | 可用内存。
en: Computer: desktop FPS | CPU | used / total RAM | available RAM.

source: 桌面 FPS 测量 Windows 桌面合成帧率；游戏独立呈现的帧率不在此测量范围内。
en: Desktop FPS measures Windows desktop composition. Independently presented game frames are outside this measurement.

source: 应用内显示本应用 UI 帧率与内存；桌面浮窗显示桌面 FPS、电脑 CPU 与总内存。
en: In-app: this app's UI FPS and memory. Desktop: desktop FPS, computer CPU and physical RAM.

source: 每秒后台采样；桌面 FPS 为实测合成帧率。电脑内存显示已用、总量与可用量。
en: Samples in the background once a second. Desktop FPS measures composition frames. RAM includes used, total and available.

source: 应用内显示本应用 UI 帧率与内存；桌面浮窗显示电脑 CPU 与总内存。
en: In-app: this app's UI FPS and memory. Desktop: computer CPU and physical RAM.

source: 每秒后台采样；电脑内存显示已用、总量与可用量。UI FPS 仅代表本应用。
en: Samples in the background once a second. RAM includes used, total and available. UI FPS applies only to this app.

source: 电脑：CPU | 已用 / 总内存 | 可用内存。
en: Computer: CPU | used / total RAM | available RAM.

source: 本应用：UI FPS | 工作集 / 专用内存 | 电脑总内存。
en: This app: UI FPS | working set / private memory | computer's physical RAM total.

source: 此电脑有多个处理器组，暂不显示不完整的 CPU 占用。
en: This computer has multiple processor groups. Partial CPU usage is not displayed.

source: 性能显示的最后调整尚未保存。可以取消后重试，或不保存并退出。
en: The last performance display changes have not been saved. Cancel to retry, or quit without saving.

source: 本应用：FPS | 工作集 / 专用内存。
en: This app: FPS | working set / private memory.
UI rendering callbacks for this app only; not game FPS.
source: UI 回调计数，仅代表本应用；不是游戏帧率。

en: Position uses DIP inside the app and screen pixels for the overlay. Size uses DIP.
source: 应用内位置为 DIP，浮窗位置为屏幕像素；尺寸为 DIP。

en: Drag when unlocked. Return here to unlock a locked display.
source: 解锁后可拖动浮窗。锁定时可在这里解锁。

en: Sampling stops while the display is off.
This environment uses a solid background.
source: 此运行环境使用纯色背景。

en: This process memory updates once a second. FPS is counted while the main window is not minimized.
source: 每秒更新本进程的内存；帧率统计仅在主窗口未最小化时进行。
